disputed_or_unresolved: Riley/Griscti IV.10 p.322 prose gives 3 1/3 hours after 37.5 days divided by twelve; table gives Mars 3 days 3 hours (75 hours). Implemented profile follows Brennan table units, not this prose error.
IV.10 pp.323–324 worked remainder assigns Taurus 1 day 21 hours; table Taurus unit is 1 day 16 hours. That worked remainder and its ancient Mesori date are not claimed verified.
Valens IV.4 includes qualitative cross-lot substitution and age/sex discussion; these historical interpretive exceptions are recorded but not automatically applied in this modern profile.
Full bonification/maltreatment, completion/culmination and qualitative outcome delineation remain unsupported.
validation_scope: Published Gemini 211-month/bond example, Brennan handout L1–L4 units, and Diana Fortune bond date 1997-07-22 from episode 192. These verify arithmetic/procedure, not real-world predictive validity.
